title: Component-by-Component Scientific Ablation
description: Progressive ablation matrix showing skill metric evolution from Raw NWP to 2-Stage Post-Processing.

components.name: Raw ECMWF IFS (0.25°)
components.description: Uncalibrated operational numerical weather prediction model output.
components.operational_flaw: Severe dry bias over Western Ghats; misses 82% of heavy rain events.

components.name: Global Empirical Quantile Mapping (EQM)
components.description: Single transfer function across all dates and locations without synoptic distinction.
components.operational_flaw: Overpredicts during Break monsoon; generates spurious coastal rain.

components.name: Regime-Aware RQDM (Stage 1)
components.description: Conditioned transfer functions per synoptic regime (Active, Break, Normal).
components.operational_flaw: Removes synoptic bias (+0.06 ETS gain); does not adjust sub-grid orography.

components.name: Full 2-Stage Post-Processing (RQDM + LightGBM)
components.description: Gradient boosted residual correction with terrain elevation, distance to coast, and 850 hPa wind flux.
components.operational_flaw: Optimal continuous RMSE (15.2 mm vs 18.7 mm) & lowest FAR (43% vs 70%).
